title: The Pied Piper of Hamelin
prompt: Describe the main problem faced by the town of Hamelin in the story.
hint: Think about what kind of pest is causing trouble in the town.
sample: The town of Hamelin had a serious rat problem that threatened their food supplies and safety.

title: The Pied Piper's Offer
prompt: Explain the deal the Pied Piper offers to the town to solve their problem.
hint: Consider the payment he asks for and the condition of the deal.
sample: The Pied Piper offers to remove all the rats from Hamelin in exchange for 1,000 gold coins, but only if he succeeds.

sample: The people refused to pay the full 1,000 gold coins and offered only 50 coins, claiming the original amount was too high.
